Docket 1.3.141

**Docket is free to try: run a full audit of any site without a key and see your score, how many problems each area has, and the most important problem in full with its fix. [Buy it once](https://kerr-affiliate-hub.kerrco.workers.dev/buy/docket?src=release-notes), $59, or $29.50 at the Black Friday price until 30 November, to see all the others, the ranked fix plan and the markup to paste. 30-day refund, no conditions.**

- *Ask your AI assistant about your audits, not only to run one.* Claude, the ChatGPT desktop app or any assistant
  that speaks MCP can now get your last audit back without crawling again, have one problem explained in full with
  its fix and the markup to paste, and compare two audits of the same site to see what got better, what got worse
  and what is new. Audits your assistant runs are kept, and appear in Reports beside the ones you run in the app.
  Setup takes one line: https://docketseo.app/how-to/audit-your-site-from-an-ai-assistant/
- *Reports marks a score that is not a verdict.* When Docket could not read enough of a site to judge it, the
  report says so, but the Reports list showed the audit with an ordinary score beside the others. It now marks it,
  as the results screen does.

99 checks across 13 areas.
